summary: Send the raw clay-api-key header only on /public/ paths, read from the environment at request time.
reason: Clay serves two APIs from one host with two credentials: /v3 authenticates with the claysession browser cookie and /public/v0 with a raw clay-api-key header. Each API rejects the other's credential, and the generated client stamped the key on every request, so all /v3 commands returned 401.
validated_outcome: Verified live: /v3 and /public/v0 both authenticate simultaneously with the env key exported.
